description: Rishabh Pant has endured a turbulent year, losing his Test vice-captaincy and his place in the ODIs, but his response remains unmistakably his own. In Wellington, he turned a cautious start into an audacious century, completing the SENA set and silencing critics, if only temporarily. Through the noise, scrutiny and setbacks, Pant continues to entertain, defy convention and remind everyone why he remains unignorable.

The club pledged to invest 10% of all partnership revenue into programmes that strengthen the city. Introduced in 2021, before Patrick joined the ownership group in 2023, the initiative has supported youth sports, local organisations and opportunities for women and girls across Kansas City.

author: SUKHMANI KOONER
description: A family invested nearly Rs 2 crore to establish a cloth retail business in Zirakpur. They faced significant delays and unpaid assured returns after the agreement with the developer. The family reported the project's construction halted, leading to their refund request being denied. The State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission ordered a refund with interest due to the developer's failure.

author: MAHIMA SHARMA
description: At a recent auction, a rare lock of George Washington’s hair sold for an impressive $4,000. This fascinating artifact once belonged to John Gadsby, who shared a meal with Washington shortly before his passing. Gadsby’s granddaughter later cherished the lock alongside a portrait of the first president, making it a remarkable piece of history. Notably, Washington's hair has previously commanded prices nearing $40,000 at auctions, alongside other treasured memorabilia.
title: Former US President George Washington's hair sells for $4,000

description: In the wake of a devastating building collapse in Brooklyn that claimed eight lives, a musician has taken legal action against the landlord for ignoring warnings about visible cracks weeks prior. The lawsuit also raises alarms about nearby construction projects lacking proper structural support. Authorities are now probing the oversight of such projects in densely populated neighborhoods, questioning the responsiveness to residents' concerns before the tragic incident occurred.

description: AI giant Anthropic has celebrated a milestone initial public offering, amassing a staggering $81.3 billion, which catapults its valuation to an impressive $1.5 trillion. Kevin O'Leary, an influential investor, commended the company's enterprise-driven approach focused on instilling trust and security among business clients. Notably, Amazon holds a substantial 14.7% share worth $225 billion, while Alphabet, Google's parent company, controls 13.

author: JYOTIRMOY HALDER
description: Grandmaster Peter Leko’s dramatic clash against Vladimir Kramnik in 2004 was the last World Chess Championship hosted in Switzerland. During an exclusive interaction with TimesofIndia.com, the Hungarian chess veteran reflects on the psychological pressure, preparation challenges and dramatic final game of that encounter, while drawing parallels with the upcoming Gukesh–Sindarov title clash in Geneva.
title: Facebook, Kramnik-Leko and a 22-year wait: Switzerland prepares for Gukesh-Sindarov clash

description: Rishabh Pant achieved a remarkable milestone by scoring Test centuries in all four SENA countries. His latest contribution was a century against New Zealand in Wellington. This century marked his return to international cricket after a brief injury hiatus. Pant is now the third Indian wicketkeeper to attain nine Test centuries. He has also surpassed Brendon McCullum in the list of most sixes in Test cricket.

description: Naomi Osaka revealed that her daughter, Shai, was the reason she skipped the Cincinnati Open ahead of the 2026 US Open. Despite enjoying a strong North American hardcourt season, the four-time Grand Slam champion felt she had played enough matches and needed to be home with her three-year-old. Osaka also discussed her approach to Shai's future, saying she would not pressure her daughter to pursue professional tennis.

Aarna's impressive collection of over 100 medals from various competitions, both national and international, showcases her prowess.

author: TNN
description: Asaduddin Owaisi arrived at the Saharanpur circuit house for a scheduled meeting regarding a mosque demolition. Police guards mistakenly accorded him a ceremonial guard of honour, which was intended for a Supreme Court judge. The confusion arose due to the timing of both arrivals, leading to an unusual situation. Following the incident, Saharanpur police clarified the error and initiated an inquiry into the protocol lapse.
title: Police mistakenly salute Owaisi; inquiry ordered over protocol lapse

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: According to railway officials, the braking arrangement of the passenger train had to be connected to the braking system of the freight locomotive assigned to pull it for the entire journey. However, railway personnel allegedly failed to ensure that the two systems were properly integrated. They also reportedly proceeded with the movement despite the train crew raising concerns about the braking performance.
title: Empty Vande Bharat train travels 463 km with faulty brakes; probe ordered

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: India's 720/9 became the biggest total ever scored in a Test innings on New Zealand soil. The previous best was the hosts' 715/6 declared against Bangladesh in Hamilton in 2019. India also broke the record for the highest Test total against New Zealand. The West Indies had earlier held the record with their 660/5 declared at the Basin Reserve in Wellington in 1995.
title: 720/9! Team India rewrite record books, post highest-ever Test total in NZ

description: Iran has released footage claiming it struck a US F-16 fighter jet over the Persian Gulf. The video purportedly shows a missile hitting the aircraft, causing an emergency landing. While Washington denied the claim, insisting no F-16 was attacked, Iran insisted on its air defense's action against the aircraft. It clarified the operation was conducted by the Iranian Army's Air Defence.

author: YASHIKA BAJAJ
description: Nine individuals died in a tragic accident involving a vehicle carrying family members in Rajasthan. The group was returning home from visiting a religious shrine in Khatu Shyam. The accident occurred near Shambhupura on the Kota-Udaipur highway during the night. Authorities are ensuring that the injured receive the necessary medical treatment and care. Post-mortem procedures for the deceased are being conducted by the local administration.
title: 9 family members killed as pilgrims' vehicle crashes into truck in Rajasthan

author: GEORGE MENDONCA
description: Maharashtra Pollution Control Board issued a stop-work notice to Adani Renewable Energy One Ltd for unauthorized activities. The notice was the result of an inspection on ongoing excavation and construction in Sawarghar village. The company failed to secure required permissions and environmental clearance for its development projects. Following complaints, the board emphasized the need for compliance with pollution control measures.
title: Maha pollution board tells Adani firm to halt work

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: For nearly thirty years, Mundubai Irappa Davre from Latur, Maharashtra, battled to reclaim her 4.5 acres of farmland after losing it to a moneylender. Despite the struggles and obstacles she faced, including borrowing Rs 25,000 for her daughter's wedding, she persevered. Recently, district officials intervened, leading to the restoration of her land ownership without any repayment obligations, shedding light on the intricate challenges rural families encounter in financial disputes.
title: Latur woman gets land papers back after 30 years, lost 4.5 acres for Rs 25k loan

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: In a complex legal battle over a Phoenix property, Robert Olsen asserted his ownership via a deed from 2015. His father's mistake in addressing the deed was countered by the accurate legal description, raising legal challenges. Following a transfer to a business entity in 2019, disputes escalated. Ultimately, the Arizona Court of Appeals affirmed Olsen's deed, nullifying subsequent transfers and clarifying his rightful ownership while clearing invalid records.
title: Arizona dad's 2015 deed had wrong address; court backs son, voids later deeds
